mostWorthwhile.text: Making ATP and then using it to power the membrane pump was worthwhile: the pictures connected food and oxygen to a specific cell job.

leastWorthwhile.text: Supplying the cell with glucose felt like a small intermediate step; it set up the next combination but did not yet show the energy process.

surprise.text: The pump moved particles toward the more crowded side using ATP. I hadn't known why a cell would need energy for that direction of transport.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The ATP arrows and matching shapes gave reasons for the pairings, although I was following the diagrams rather than understanding every detail of how the proteins work.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how these cell pieces connect to larger body structures. The pictures made the connections understandable without needing to know all the details beforehand.
